description.en:
Walker S and Walker S1 represent successive UBTECH industrial humanoid platforms. Both combine human-scale mobility with perception and manipulation for work in manufacturing environments. Their development centers on integrating the robot into production workflows rather than treating locomotion as a standalone demonstration.

Walker S introduces force-feedback joints, navigation and whole-body manipulation, while Walker S1 emphasizes task planning, semantic visual navigation and learned coordination of perception and control. This family-level grouping covers both models; hardware figures and application results should be checked against the individual version instead of assigning a shared specification to the pair.
